notes: School district, modified cash basis (first year after dissolved-district merger; beginning balances are zero and the 4,968,148.15 'Cash balance from dissolved district' is printed in total receipts but shown as a Special Item on the Statement of Activities, so it is recorded in adjustments; reported receipts total ties via includes_split). Receipts, disbursements and ending cash use the Governmental Funds (total) column after reclassifications on Exhibit D (p5); labels come from the fund statement on p4. The reclassification column eliminates 127,044.91 of transfers (116,000 general fund transfers out; 11,044.91 hidden inside the General Fund's Special education 0-5 program lines, transferred to the Cooperative Fund), so no transfers appear at the total level and transfers_in/out are null. 'Taxes: Other' 1,376,314.65 (p5) is split into property tax credit 1,330,183.74, homestead 26,476.85, pro-rate 8,913.97 and nameplate 10,740.09 using the General Fund (Exh. G p8: 1,353,519.45) and QCPU (Exh. M p15: 22,795.20) breakdowns. Balance sheet = Statement of Net Position (p1); fund balance sheet on p3 not used. Detail: Exhibit G (General Fund budgetary comparison, program lines) plus Exhibits H, I, K, L, M, N, O. For expenditures, the object-level Exhibit P (Cash Disbursements for Operational Expenses - General Fund, pp18-24; the v7 re-trim added report pp40-44, so it is now complete through its Transfers section and Total Cash Disbursements 5,254,317.95 on p24) replaces every program line of Exhibit G, so nothing is double counted; only Exhibit G's 8000 Transfers line and the two hidden-transfer contra/other-financing pairs stay under Exhibit G, whose total (p10) counts the Exhibit P lines via includes_schedules. The General Fund Components combining schedule (pp6-7) duplicates those lines and was not recorded. The 275,000 allocation to the Depreciation Fund is embedded in student transportation - regular (Exhibit F reclassification, p7); Exhibit P shows it as Vehicle Operation Capital Assets 275,000.00 (p23), kept as printed with a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line; likewise the 11,044.91 General Fund to Cooperative Fund transfer inside the Special education 0-5 lines has a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line (Exhibit D p5, Cooperative Fund p16). The printed G disbursement total 5,254,317.95 includes that 275,000 and the 116,000 transfers. Student activity accounts (181,667.27 assigned fund balance) still have no schedule in the trimmed PDF (the pages added by the v7 re-trim are all Exhibit P), so the student fee/activities receipts residual below stays derived. Budget amounts of '-' recorded as 0; budget columns on other fund schedules are only totals, so budget_final null. Recheck: 'Other student support' (Other Governmental Funds, p4) split into school nutrition 255,826.49 (Exh K) and student fee/activities residual 257,852.74; 'Other local receipts' split to show Cooperative Fund receipts from other districts 117,912.69 (Exh N) as intergovernmental. Outside-review fix: the 'Cash balance from dissolved district' lines in the fund schedules (detail) moved from revenue/other to section 'other financing' (not revenue, matching the top-level adjustment); the schedules' revenue totals mark includes other financing. Read pages 1-24 of 24.
